transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess what pushed me to make this appointment is just... having some issues at work. 

I keep starting follow-up items after my audits, or these mentorship events we do. I always have every intention of finishing them. But then I'll find out days later that the final email, or a review note, or a form... just never actually got done. 

So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you find it hard to focus or stay attentive, especially when you’re supposed to complete tasks like those emails or forms?

Um... yeah, I guess. It's... well, like if I'm in a long client meeting. Or one of those AI-tool trainings we have to do. I'll start out fine, fully engaged. But after a while... my mind just kind of slips off. I'll suddenly realize I completely missed the last few minutes, even though I'm still just sitting there looking right at the screen. So... yes.
Do you find your mind wandering or having trouble staying focused in situations outside of work, like during conversations, reading, or watching TV?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed it outside of work, I don't think. I guess... I just watch TV normally. I haven't really paid attention to whether my mind wanders then.
When you're at home, do you ever find yourself losing track of conversations, missing parts of TV shows, or forgetting things like where you put your keys or what you walked into a room for?

Um... I don't really know about my keys. But... I guess I do forget things I absolutely mean to do. 

Like... paying a bill before the late fee hits. Or even just... calling a junior staff member back, or putting a mentorship event on my calendar after I've already agreed to it. I just... forget. So, yeah.
Can you think of any examples outside of work where you’ve forgotten things you meant to do, like appointments, chores, or returning phone calls?

Um... not really. I... I can't really think of anything. My personal life is pretty quiet, so... I don't really have a lot of appointments to keep track of anyway. I haven't really noticed it with chores or anything like that. So... no.
Do you ever notice yourself losing focus or having trouble staying attentive during activities at home, like reading, watching TV, or talking with friends or family?

Um... well... you're asking about at home again. I... I don't really know about reading or TV. 

But... I guess... it happens with work things. Like, I can start a long client meeting, or... or some training for a new AI tool, and I'll be fully engaged at first. But then... after a while, my mind just slips off. I'll realize I've missed the last few minutes, even though I'm still sitting there... just looking right at the screen. So... I don't know about at home, but... it happens then.
Can you think of any situations outside of work, like at home or in social settings, where you’ve had trouble staying focused or found yourself forgetting things you meant to do?

Um... no, not really. I... I think I already mentioned that my personal life is pretty quiet. I don't really do much outside of work, so... there isn't really anything to lose focus on. I just... I don't really have any examples for you.

So you mentioned your personal life is quiet, but can you think of any small everyday situations — like remembering to take medication, finishing a task around the house, or even following a conversation with someone — where you’ve noticed yourself forgetting things or not staying focused?

Um... no. I... I don't take any medication, so that's not an issue. And... I just do the basic things around the house. I don't really keep track of whether I lose focus while doing them, it's just... stuff that gets done eventually. I... I really just can't think of anything like what you're asking.

So you've mentioned that you notice these issues mostly at work, but can you recall any instance—no matter how small—where you noticed similar problems at home, like while doing something routine or following a conversation with someone?

Um... I mean, I guess there are some things. But it's mostly... work-related stuff that spills over. 

Like... I'll forget things I really meant to do. I might tell a junior staff member I'll call them back, and then... I just don't. Or I'll agree to go to a mentorship event, and I just... forget to actually put it on my calendar. 

I guess... sometimes I'll forget to pay a bill before the late fee hits, even though I knew it was due. So... I don't know. Just... things like that.
Can you think of any time—whether at home, with friends, or in any other setting outside of work—when you've noticed the same kind of forgetfulness or loss of focus that you're describing at work?

I... no. I really can't. Like I said, I just... I don't really do much outside of work. I go home, I eat, I sleep. There's not... there's not really anything going on where I'd notice that kind of thing. I'm sorry, I just... I don't have anything else to tell you about that.
Have you noticed these problems with inattention or forgetfulness in more than one situation, like at work and during your free time, or have they only happened in specific circumstances?

I... well. I suppose it's both. I just... I didn't really want to get into the home stuff earlier. 

But... yes. At work, the mistakes and... the unfinished follow-ups... it actually reached a point recently where a client review was affected. I'm worried people are starting to question whether I can even handle the promotion I'm up for. 

And... at home... my husband actually had to take over the bills. And other commitments I agreed to. He just... he can't count on me to complete them reliably anymore. So... yeah. I guess it's everywhere.
Do you often feel restless, fidgety, or unusually active—especially in situations where others might expect you to sit still or stay calm?

I suppose... yes. Sometimes. 

When I have to sit through a long review or something like that, it's... difficult. It just feels physically uncomfortable. Like there's this pressure building up inside me. Eventually, I just... I have to stand up. I'll go to the printer, or just find some excuse to move around. It's hard to just sit there.
Do you often find yourself acting quickly without thinking things through, like interrupting someone during a conversation or making sudden decisions without considering the consequences?

I... yes. I guess I do that. Sometimes I catch myself... jumping into conversations before people finish. Mostly with the junior auditors at work. 

It's just... if I know the answer, or an idea comes to me, it feels so urgent in my head. I end up blurting it out before I can stop myself. So... yes.
